proposed_widenings.name: create_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The core mechanic is deploying a persistent environmental structure from the item, with reversible form change and retained damage. The current surface has `alter_item_kind`, but not a way to create or deploy a tower-sized object into the world as a traced mechanical payload.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower.

proposed_widenings.name: activation_resource.at_will
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations currently require a resource pool and reset cadence. Instant Fortress is reusable on demand with no charges, uses, or rest reset, so the existing activation family cannot encode it honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form...

proposed_widenings.name: deployed_structure_with_revert_and_object_push
proposed_widenings.justification: The item creates a structure occupying an area, pushes creatures and unattended objects clear when it appears, then later reverts only if empty while preserving accumulated damage. That is more than a simple item-kind rename and needs explicit deployment / occupancy / revert semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are also pushed clear of the tower. ... Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty. ... Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower.

notes: No content file authored. The current magic-item activation surface cannot represent an unlimited reusable activation, and the deployed-tower mechanic needs object-creation/deployment support beyond the existing surfaced atoms.
